steps.summary: Each screen is designed, with its wording, and the build is planned.
The manager can sign in, plan a week of shifts and publish it; first sign-in asks staff for their own password.
The manager adds and removes staff and decides swaps; staff see their own published shifts and ask to swap.
Ready for a private link: hidden from search engines, every page answers, all checks pass.
Browser checks for all four core flows (12 checks) written and passing on the test copy.
Walked every screen; fixed mismatched table headings, the tab marker and the app name wrapping on phones.
Reviewed every route; closed a password-change hole and the starting-password gap. One open point needs you: claim the manager account first.
